name: Interactive Repulsion Grid
description: Full-screen canvas dot grid where dots swell near the pointer or finger, revealing an image through the growing dots like a halftone mask.
contents: Full-viewport canvas with a regular grid of dots
Cover-fitted image visible only through the dots
behavior: Dots near the mouse or touch point grow with distance falloff and ease back when it moves away
Image is clipped by the dot shapes, dots show as solid color until the image loads
Canvas and grid rebuild on window resize
editableByProps: Image, grid spacing, dot size, reach and max growth of the pointer effect, easing speed

needsCodeEdit.change: Shrink dots near the pointer instead of growing
Use square dots instead of circles

fixed: Canvas always matches the window size, not the container
Listens to window mouse and touch movement while mounted and removes listeners on unmount
